title: Grateful Dead Live at Carousel Ballroom on 1968-02-14

ai_review.summary: Legendary soundboard recording featuring an all‑time great second set and a masterful Alligator performance.
ai_review.review: Fans hail this show as one of the Dead’s finest, with a superb first set and a second set that ranks among the greatest ever – even feeding material for Anthem of the Sun. The soundboard source is praised as a legendary capture, making it a must‑keep in any collection.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong praise for both performance and recording from the primary review; limited quantitative data (only one detailed review) keeps confidence at medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No specific complaints; reviewers describe it as a legendary capture, implying clear and balanced sound.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set described as excellent; second set hailed as one of the greatest ever and a source for Anthem of the Sun material.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Reviewer notes being mesmerized by Jerry's guitar work and stage presence, calling it "wow fucking cool man".
